_why: CISCOPE1c (D207, design docs/2026-10-24-ci-scope-design.md §3.4 check 5): the files that act on every unit of a suite without being named, which tools/test-map.mjs reads from the tree and holds to this list. Such a file runs its suite whole; the list makes that visible, and a new one fails the census's check until it is listed here with why.

wholeSuite.src/Daoris.Service/Daoris.Service.Http.T: the HTTP tests' assembly fixture: every class shares the host it starts
a global using of the service's HTTP tests
the service's HTTP tests' project file
wholeSuite.src/Daoris.Service/Daoris.Service.Tests/: a global using of the service's tests
wholeSuite.src/Daoris.Devkit/Daoris.Devkit.Tests/Gl: a global using of the devkit's tests
wholeSuite.src/Daoris.Desktop/Daoris.Desktop.Driver: a global using of the driver's tests, every half
the driver's tests' project file, every half
wholeSuite.src/Daoris.Desktop/Daoris.Desktop.Module: a global using of the modules' tests, both halves
the modules' tests' assembly attribute: one class at a time
the modules' tests' project file, both halves
wholeSuite.src/Daoris.Desktop/process.runsettings: the Process halves' run settings (MOD8, PROCPAR1)
wholeSuite.src/Daoris.Desktop/git.process.runsettin: the driver's git half's run settings (PROC1c)
wholeSuite.src/Daoris.Desktop/Directory.Build.props: every desktop project builds with it
wholeSuite.src/Daoris.Devkit/Directory.Build.props: every devkit project builds with it
wholeSuite.src/Daoris.Service/Directory.Build.props: every service project builds with it
wholeSuite.src/Daoris.Cli/tsconfig.json: the CLI's compiler settings, which its tests and the tool-tests run under
wholeSuite.src/Daoris.Cli/package.json: the CLI's scripts, which choose its tests' and the tool-tests' files
wholeSuite.src/Daoris.Web/vite.config.ts: the vitests' configuration: their environment, pool, include and timeout
wholeSuite.src/Daoris.Web/src/test/setup.tsx: vitest's setupFiles: run before every page test
